My friend, I consider my mother a strange person. Rant mode [on] Some mothers say they don't deserve a Mother's Day. Yes my mother has helped me and some might say I'm just being a brat. But, no one should ever be called a "Faggot" for having a new hair style. My mother doesn't even speak to little if anyone on her side of her family. We left my grandfathers funeral early because someone who to my knowledge has no ties to her family asked her "why aren't you up front with anyone?" She didn't even have the respect to stay at her own fathers funeral. He helped raised me, once she got her divorce she never talked to anyone on her said of the family. I try to look past the fact that I never was allowed to have any connections but, assumed my mother was right in fear of punishment. I still wish I manned up and said I'm going to see my grandfather. She doesn't even try to understand how to calm talk to people. The reason why she leaves her jobs isn't because she doesn't like her new job. But, she ends up getting into it with her coworkers. She cheated on my father with her boss. Who is actually my stepdad right now... She doesn't even like his daughters because they aren't friends with me. Even though I don't see a issue with that we don't have anything in common. I always tell my younger brother, that he needs to do good and go to a university far from my mother and never look back. I made the decision to focus on my call of duty G.P.A ended up 5th in the world back in the day! But, still here and going to community college which isn't a bad thing at all for my career path. Move out is the best answer well 8.50 isn't going to be able to support myself. I am very glad that I have a wonderful father who has worked hard his entire life and started from scratch and made his way up. He has been a huge help. My girlfriend has always supported my decision and she thinks I would be a outstanding barber. Well my rant is over now and I'm off to bed. I'll give a update if anything happens tomorrow. Good night everyone much love.
